newsitem.title: USA: Futures group website to take fraud complaints.
newsitem.headline: Futures group website to take fraud complaints.

text.p: The National Futures Association (NFA) has begun accepting complaints and reports of fraud or abuse in the commodity futures industry over the Internet, the NFA announced Tuesday.

Investors can make complaints and report fraud by sending e-mail to "inquiry@nfa.futures.org". The NFA said complaints and reports of possible investment swindles would be referred immediately to the appropriate department.
Investors can also request background checks on futures market firms by sending e-mail to the address above or by accessing NFA's website at "http://www.nfa.futures.org", the association said.
"There is no other group within the investment community that allows you to do a background check over the Internet" or electronically file a complaint, an NFA spokesman said.
The NFA is the self-regulatory agency of the futures industry.
